status: Capture intentionally stopped after parent/user priority change; no EBS implementation or documentation edits

native_observations.contract: With the observed account encryption default disabled, omitted flags and explicit Encrypted=false produced unencrypted snapshots; Encrypted=true plus the owned key, key-only, and Encrypted=true with the existing default key produced encrypted snapshots.
Encrypted=false plus KmsKeyArn rejects with HTTP 400 ValidationException, Reason INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE, message 'Encrypt cannot be false when KmsKeyArn is specified'.

EC2 State=completed is not proof of EBS direct readiness. An immediate ListSnapshotBlocks returned HTTP 404 ResourceNotFoundException/SNAPSHOT_NOT_FOUND, and parent admission returned HTTP 400 ValidationException/INVALID_SNAPSHOT_ID with source snapshot not complete. The second run's unencrypted snapshot became list-readable after eleven five-second readiness waits.
native_observations.additional_evidence: encryption.json: plain-state-1 and plain-readiness-0 through plain-readiness-11

native_observations.contract: Correlated management events show EBS StartSnapshot invoked KMS GenerateDataKey with numberOfBytes=64 and encryptionContext aws:ebs:id equal to the new snapshot ID. userIdentity.invokedBy and userAgent are ebs.amazonaws.com. This is GenerateDataKey, not GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext. ViaService condition context was not measured and must not be inferred from invokedBy.
Native StartSnapshot management events replace response kmsKeyArn with HIDDEN_DUE_TO_SECURITY_REASONS. CompleteSnapshot returned status pending in captured events.

primary_documentation_only.contract: EBS direct snapshot resource ARN uses EC2 namespace and an empty account component: arn:${Partition}:ec2:${Region}::snapshot/${SnapshotId}. StartSnapshot has dependent ec2:CreateTags authorization when creating tags; resource tags and request tags are distinct supported condition keys.
ParentSnapshotId disallows any explicit Encrypted or KmsKeyArn. With both omitted an encrypted child inherits its parent's key. Encryption-by-default enabled rejects an unencrypted parent.

unmeasured: Native restricted-IAM allow/deny and dependent-action matrix; no role, user, inline policy or access key was created
KMS permission subsets, disabled-key behavior, ViaService values and encryption-context IAM conditions
Completed encrypted-parent inheritance and explicit parent/encryption incompatibility matrix
Regional/account isolation and cross-account sharing; no public sharing was attempted
Encryption-by-default enabled account; defaults and existing keys/policies were not changed
CloudTrail block data events; no trail selectors, CloudTrail Lake or audit configuration was created or changed
Second run had nine not-yet-visible management call events at its final read-only lookup; missing events are listed in encryption.json and are not invented

cleanup.verification: Both captures contain successful DeleteSnapshot receipts, an empty description-prefix/owner-scoped DescribeSnapshots inventory, and DescribeKey showing PendingDeletion after snapshot deletion.
cleanup.cost_boundary: The two customer-managed keys remain physically present until their mandatory deletion dates. AWS states keys scheduled for deletion incur no key-storage charge unless deletion is cancelled. Prior short-lived key/snapshot storage and API usage may incur small charges; no account billing total was queried.
